content.text:
cd /workspace && git commit -m "feat: enable full Kulturhuset event fetch with pagination
ROOT CAUSE:
Kulturhuset API returns 1,296 events, but only 61 were reaching the database.
The sourceRunner.ts limited Kulturhuset to 50 events with no pagination.
DROP-OFF ANALYSIS:
- Kulturhuset API: 1,296 events available
- After limit (50): 50 events fetched
- After queue: ~50 events
- After normalizer: ~50 events
- In Supabase: 61 events (includes some from previous runs)
- In UI: ~61 events
FIX:
1. Added pagination support to fetchKulturhusetEvents():
   - New fetchAll option to fetch all pages automatically
   - Configurable limit per page (default 100)
   - Safety limit of 100 pages to prevent infinite loops
   - Console logging of total events fetched
2. Updated sourceRunner.ts:
   - Changed from limit: 50 to fetchAll: true
   - Kulturhuset now fetches ALL ~1,296 events
   - Updated standalone runKulturhusetSource() to use pagination
EXPECTED RESULT:
- Before: ~61 events in database (95% data loss)
- After: ~1,296 events in database (full coverage)
VERIFICATION:
- TypeScript compiles without errors
- No mock data introduced
- Real Kulturhuset events from Elasticsearch API"
[main a59679db] feat: enable full Kulturhuset event fetch with pagination
 2 files changed, 45 insertions(+), 6 deletions(-)
